# Code Anchors: Issue-Sourced Planning

- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.ts` — orchestrates the reconstruction: fetch, classify each sub-issue as record or story, build the dependency graph, serialize, and write the materialized epic, failing closed if any referenced sub-issue is unfetchable or a second record candidate appears.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — record-vs-story classification for the sub-issue set, resolved through the shared publishing resolver across a process seam, with case-folded label matching.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/gh.ts` — fetches the epic issue, its sub-issues (with label names), their issue types, and their native dependency edges from GitHub (read-only).
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/serialize.ts` — canonical, byte-stable serialization of the epic field shape, emitting the record sub-issue's number and state as frontmatter only when one exists.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/meta.ts` — reads the hidden frontmatter machine comment off the issue body, falling back to recoverable fields alone for a hand-filed epic.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/render.ts` — renders the resolved epic into the existing epic markdown shape downstream parsers already read.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/write.ts` — writes the materialized epic to a path outside version control the working tree never reports as new.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/run.ts` — the resolver CLI entry point.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/diagnostic.ts` — the fail-closed diagnostics, including the unresolved-classification and multiple-record-sub-issue aborts.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/serialize.spec.ts` — determinism/idempotency coverage: byte-identical output on an unchanged issue graph.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.spec.ts` — classification coverage across the three modes and the case-folding rule.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/resolve.spec.ts` — resolver coverage for the record field, the byte-identical no-record output, and the fail-closed aborts.
